label: Magmatism
text: EA.O.A2.5 Magmatism. Melt generation at ridges (decompression), subduction zones (flux melting) and hotspots. A hotspot track is evidence of plate motion over a source, interpreted, not seen. Volcanic eruption as a hazard event enters EA.O.A5.5.

warrant.warrant: W4, W2 (inversions with error), W6 (boundary comparison)
warrant.standard: Geodetic rates with uncertainty; tomography with resolution test
warrant.defeaters: Non-unique inversion; model dependence; sparse coverage
